text:
The most common yellow fruit that monkeys also eat is the banana.

Here is the analysis of the sentence "Whales, the largest mammals on Earth, sing to communicate." with parts of speech labeled:

**Whales**, (Noun - Subject)
**the** (Article/Determiner)
**largest** (Adjective - Superlative)
**mammals** (Noun - Appositive)
**on** (Preposition)
**Earth** (Noun - Object of Preposition)
**,** (Punctuation)
**sing** (Verb - Predicate)
**to** (Particle/Infinitive marker)
**communicate** (Verb - Infinitive)
 **.** (Punctuation)
